rules.trigger: Use when product detail price, promotion price, SKU popup price, cart price, checkout price, coupon selection, wallet amount, or order amount is inconsistent or repeatedly fixed.
rules.do: Name the shared invariant and map every surface that displays or mutates it: product detail, promotion card, SKU popup, cart, checkout, order create, wallet payment, and refund. Patch the shared implementation point when one exists and preserve known-good sibling surfaces.

rules.trigger: Use when source code looks fixed but product detail, promotion, cart, checkout, or SKU popup still shows stale prices or stale activity state.
rules.do: Classify stale runtime, Redis, ES, frontend bundle, mini-program/H5 page cache, old service process, or DB state before editing code again. Verify active runtime project and served source before claiming the fix is visible.

rules.trigger: Use when the scenario is order, payment, fulfillment, cancellation, aftersale, coupon, inventory, middle-platform status sync, store/rider flow, H5 checkout, or mini-program checkout.
rules.do: Classify the scenario with the universal E2E workflow. For FULL_E2E, create a scenario contract and matrix covering login, address, cart, checkout, coupon, wallet payment, middle-platform push, sourcing, store preparation, rider acceptance, pickup, delivery, completion, status consistency, wallet/refund ledger, stock, and logs as applicable.

rules.trigger: Use when product/promotion/coupon/order behavior drifts between frontend UI state and backend domain state.
rules.do: Backend owns security, persistence, money, state transitions, invariants, and reusable domain facts. Frontend owns display state, selected UI state, tabs, dialogs, labels, local formatting, and non-security presentation filters unless a server-side invariant requires otherwise.

evidence_sources: user repeated product price and promotion fix samples
